headlines.title: [ 2026 모태펀드] 출자 63% 증액, '넥스트유니콘' 전진 배치
headlines.summary: 이 기사는 2026년 01월 28일 17시 07분 넘버스 유료 사이트에 발행된 기사입니다. / 그래픽 = 박진화 기자 올해 중소벤처기업부 소관 모태펀드 1차 정시 출자사업 규모가 지난해와 비교해 60% 이상 대폭 늘었다. 지난해 하반기 추가경정예산을 투입해 2차 정시 사업에 편성했던 넥스트 유니콘 프로젝트를 올해는 1차로 전진 배치한 영향이다.

headlines.title: 구윤철 " 공공조달 , AI 혁신 의 마중물로"…AI 전용트랙 신설
headlines.summary: 핵심요약 구윤철 부총리, 뉴로메카 방문…혁신조달 기업 대표들과 간담회 혁신·우수제품 'AI 전용 트랙' 도입…'국산부품 의무화' 공급망 강화 구윤철(오른쪽) 부총리 겸 재정경제부 장관이 27일 서울 성동구 소재 인공지능(AI) 혁신기업 (주)뉴로메카를 방문해 관계자의 설명을 듣고 있다.

headlines.title: " 원화 국제화 는 외환 · 금융시장 도약 핵심과제"…범정부 TF 출범

headlines.title: 재경부, '엔화→원화' 일본 현지 제3자 환전 시범거래 성공
headlines.summary: 핵심요약 일본 투자자 편의 제고…WGBI 투자여건 개선 연합뉴스 재정경제부는 27일 일본 현지에서 원화-엔화 '제3자 환전' 시범거래가 성공적으로 마무리됐다고 밝혔다. 제3자 환전은 투자자가 '해외 외국환업무 취급기관(RFI)' 등 임의의 환전은행과 외환자금을 환전하고 결제는 고객의 수탁은행을 통해 수행하는 방식을 말한다.

headlines.title: 차세대 반도체 소재·패키징도 전략기술 편입 … 투자세액공제받는다

headlines.title: 1월 국세 52.9조…증시 활황·부동산 거래증가에 전년比 13 %↑
headlines.summary: 지난해 동월 대비 6.2조 원 증가 진도율, 5년 평균 대비 1%P 높아 증시 호조에 증권거래·농특세 확대 연합뉴스 부가가치세 환급 축소와 수입 증가, 고용 개선에 따른 근로소득세 확대에 더해 증시 거래대금 증가까지 겹치면서 연초 국세 수입이 지난해 대비 늘어난 것으로 나타났다.

headlines.title: " 이 가격 맞아 ?"… 민생물가 특별관리품목, 국민 목소리 듣는다
headlines.summary: 핵심요약 정부, '민생물가 특별관리품목' 국민 제안창구 개설 국민 제안창구 배너 이미지. 재정경제부 제공 정부가 체감 물가 안정과 민생부담을 줄이기 위해 국민 목소리를 직접 듣는 제도를 도입한다. 재정경제부는 27일 한국소비자단체협의회와 함께 '민생물가 특별관리품목 국민 제안창구'를 운영한다고 밝혔다.

headlines.title: 지난해 어업생산량 8.7%↑ … 생산금액 10조 2336억 '역대 최대'

headlines.title: 정부, 구글 에 고정밀 지도 국외 반출 조건부 허가

headlines.title: “ 피지컬 AI · 수소 인프라 구축”… 현대차, 새만금 9조 투자

headlines.title: 현대차 , 새만금 에 ' 9조 ' 통 큰 투자 …'로봇·AI·수소' 핵심 거점 만든다

key_headlines.title: 2026 Mother Fund Increases Investment by 63%, 'Next Unicorn' Project Prioritized
key_headlines.summary: The initial regular investment for the 2026 Mother Fund under the Ministry of SMEs and Startups has significantly increased by over 60%. This surge is due to the 'Next Unicorn' project, previously part of a supplementary budget, now being moved to the first round of regular investments.

key_headlines.title: Deputy PM Koo Yoon-cheol: 'Public Procurement as a Catalyst for AI Innovation,' New AI-Exclusive Track Established
key_headlines.summary: Deputy Prime Minister Koo Yoon-cheol highlighted public procurement as a driving force for AI innovation during a visit to an AI firm. The government plans to introduce an 'AI-exclusive track' for innovative products in public procurement and strengthen supply chains by mandating domestic components.

key_headlines.title: 'Won Internationalization is Key for FX/Financial Market Leap,' Pan-Government TF Launched
key_headlines.summary: A pan-governmental task force has been launched to enhance accessibility to the Korean Won and expand cross-border Won transactions. A roadmap for Won internationalization, including risk management discussions, is expected to be announced in the first half of the year.

key_headlines.title: Ministry of Economy and Finance Successfully Conducts On-site JPY-KRW Third-Party Conversion Pilot in Japan
key_headlines.summary: The Ministry of Economy and Finance announced the successful completion of a pilot 'third-party currency conversion' from JPY to KRW in Japan. This new method allows investors to convert foreign exchange funds with an arbitrary exchange bank while settlement occurs through their custodian bank.

key_headlines.title: Successful KRW Third-Party Conversion Pilot in Japan, 'Helps Investment in Korean Treasury Bonds'
key_headlines.summary: The successful pilot of third-party Won conversion in Japan diversifies Won exchange routes for Japanese investors. This initiative is expected to facilitate investment in Korean treasury bonds, especially with their potential inclusion in the WGBI.

sections.Hot Economy News: The 2026 Mother Fund has seen a 63% increase in its initial regular investment, prioritizing the 'Next Unicorn' project to foster startups. Deputy Prime Minister Koo Yoon-cheol highlighted public procurement as a catalyst for AI innovation, establishing an 'AI-exclusive track' and emphasizing domestic component use. Concurrently, a pan-governmental task force was launched to internationalize the Korean Won, aiming to boost its accessibility and cross-border transactions. The Ministry of Economy and Finance successfully conducted a pilot third-party JPY-KRW conversion in Japan, streamlining the process for Japanese investors and expected to facilitate investment in Korean treasury bonds.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: Discussions on monetary policy are being influenced by AI, with considerations on whether AI boosts productivity or increases capital demand, impacting the neutral interest rate. The Bank of Korea maintained its benchmark interest rate but revised its GDP growth forecast for the year upward to 2.0% due to strong semiconductor exports and consumption recovery. Meanwhile, D-RAM and NAND export prices have surged by over 100% year-on-year, indicating a positive outlook for semiconductor giants. Globally, high inflation and financial instability in South America are driving cryptocurrency adoption as an alternative investment, and there is an ongoing debate regarding the suitability of the 2% inflation target.
sections.Financial Markets: Despite the KOSPI index reaching new highs, investors are withdrawing funds from stable, parking-type and bond ETFs, suggesting a shift towards riskier assets. However, concerns about the Middle East situation are leading to expectations of a stronger dollar, potential increases in exchange rates, and higher stock market volatility, which could impact global and domestic equities, inflation, and currency markets. Upcoming US employment, unemployment, and inflation data will be critical in assessing the Federal Reserve's future interest rate path. To counteract capital outflows to the booming stock market, savings banks are aggressively raising deposit rates, with some increasing rates by 0.60 percentage points in a month.
sections.Industry & Technology: The Korean industrial sector is experiencing a divergence, with semiconductors enjoying a super-cycle leading to record exports, while the battery sector faces challenges due to a slowdown in electric vehicle demand. February exports surged by 29% to $67.45 billion, largely driven by semiconductors, though petrochemical and steel exports declined due to global oversupply. LG Energy Solution is diversifying its battery supply to include robots, aerospace, and defense, moving beyond its traditional focus on EVs and ESS. Meanwhile, Samsung Electronics plans to fully transition its domestic and international production plants into 'AI-driven smart factories' by 2030, incorporating AI agents for quality control and humanoid robots for dangerous operations.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul's officetel and villa monthly rents have reached record highs, driven by instability and insecurity in the apartment jeonse (lump-sum deposit) market. The Seoul Housing & Communities Corporation (SH) is proceeding with the main subscription for the Magok 17-단지 'land-lease' housing, which offers long-term stable residency with public land ownership. The market is also seeing new apartment developments, particularly in areas like Banpo, Seocho, and Noryangjin. Amid a slight dip in housing prices in affluent areas like Gangnam and Yongsan, President Lee Jae-myung has signaled a policy focus on non-resident single homeowners, aiming to create conditions where selling rather than holding such properties becomes more advantageous.
sections.International Economy: The IMF has cautioned about potential US fiscal unsustainability, warning of 'national bankruptcy' due to increasing debt and the impact of former President Trump's proposed tariffs, even as it projects robust growth for the US economy. Global financial markets are reacting to US economic data, with recent PPI inflation and 'Nvidia shock' causing revisions in Federal Reserve rate cut expectations, and upcoming employment and inflation figures being closely watched. Major investment banks like JPMorgan have already lowered their 2026 US GDP growth forecasts, anticipating economic shocks from potential aggressive tariff policies. Furthermore, escalating tensions between the US and Iran pose significant risks to global energy security and supply chains, particularly impacting oil prices.
sections.AI & Economy: Hyundai Motor Group is making a significant 9 trillion won investment in Saemangeum, focusing on AI manufacturing innovation and the construction of AI data centers and solar power facilities, which is expected to create 70,000 jobs and 16 trillion won in economic effects. This trend of increased AI infrastructure investment is reflected globally, as evidenced by Dell Technologies' stock surging 22% following strong earnings, largely attributed to the expanding demand for AI data centers. These developments highlight the growing economic impact of AI-driven technology and infrastructure across diverse industries.
sections.Others: Bain Capital has increased its stake in Ecomarketing to 91% through a second tender offer, signaling a comprehensive share exchange. STgen Bio, a biopharmaceutical CMO subsidiary, is investing 110 billion won in facility expansion and staff recruitment, anticipating an IPO following increased commercial production. Concurrently, the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs has activated an emergency response system due to concerns over rising oil prices and shipping costs stemming from potential disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz, which could impact agricultural exports and commodity prices. Separately, police car insurance, previously shunned by insurers due to low profitability, is now attracting renewed interest after budget allocations increased. Finally, following reports of US airstrikes on Iran, the Presidential Office convened an NSC meeting, and President Lee Jae-myung prioritized the safety of Korean residents abroad, urging all parties to de-escalate regional tensions.
